name: Urology & men’s health (category guide)
summary: Stones, LUTS, ED / hormones — GP first vs private urology, cash clinic upsells, and foreigner fee honesty at public hospitals.
body: Urology covers stones, infections, prostate / LUTS, and many men’s-health hormone pathways; not every ED thread needs a private ‘men’s clinic’ package. Start with a GP for urine tests and basic bloods; escalate to SMC-registered Urology when imaging, procedures, or specialist meds are on the table. Public hospital private-patient routes exist; foreigners pay full fees. Boutique men’s clinics often bundle TRT / ED meds — demand labs, contraindications, and written follow-up before recurring subscriptions. Group outpatient riders may carve sexual-health or hormone therapies. Distinct from fertility/IVF listings. Category guide, not a ranked urologist list.
